one_line_summary: In August 2026, 36 villagers in Meghnapur raised and levelled a path to the village pond, and the women's group said it will keep it up.
learnings: The problem was a muddy path to the village pond that women crossed carrying water, and the village had asked the panchayat for repair several times without result.
The women listed three problems and chose the path first because every household uses the pond, so the choice is shown with its reason.
People gave stone from the old school wall and a bullock cart, and the women's group named itself to look after the path every year.
Ten days later heavy rain did not wash the path away, which is the story's own evidence that the work held.
missing: no description of what the other two problems led to
use_note: Usable inside the team now; before outside use, confirm that the named speakers agree to be quoted.
